svg.title: Råvan Talani — About & Stack
svg.desc: Råvan Talani. Founding Engineer · Marseille. Founding Engineer at Maesn, building a Unified API connecting 25+ accounting and ERP systems. M.Sc. in Sociotechnical Systems Engineering from Uppsala University. My background spans full-stack development and machine learning. These days, I'm exploring AI and agentic engineering — and always happy to swap ideas about what we're building. Stack: Languages: TypeScript · Python; Full Stack: React · Next.js · Node.js · MongoDB · PostgreSQL; AI & ML: MCP · LangChain · TensorFlow · PyTorch; Cloud & DevOps: Azure · AWS · Docker. Scroll down for projects and experiments, or visit my website for a deeper look into my life.
